integrity: Graphs are specified canonically; exact acyclic matchings and signed Morse boundaries are replayable with a standalone standard-library script. No literature result is attributed to this new calculation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for two specified twelve-vertex graphs and the component-size threshold two only. The homotopy certificate is a finite exhaustive integer computation, not a uniform polyhedral family theorem. No independent validation; bibliographic priority is not exhaustively settled.
title: Homotopy types of the two twelve-vertex Archimedean 2-independence complexes
